title: auto-refactor declarative configuration
description: Declarative registry for the auto-refactor static-analysis toolchain. Analyzers are registered purely by configuration; no engine code change is needed to add or enable one. All fields are optional — omitted values fall back to documented defaults.

format.description: Output format. 'sarif' is compatible with GitHub code scanning / CI dashboards; 'json' is the canonical machine-readable ScanReport; 'text' is human-readable.

failOnIssue.description: If true, the process exits non-zero when any 'error' issue is found (CI gate).

include.description: Glob patterns (relative to root); a file must match at least one to be scanned.

exclude.description: Glob patterns or directory names to skip.

thresholds.description: Global default thresholds; merged into every analyzer's ctx.options and overridable per-analyzer via analyzers.<name>.options.

magicNumberMin.description: constants: numeric literals with abs(value) < this are ignored.

duplicateLiteralThreshold.description: constants: a literal repeated >= this many times in a file becomes a duplicate-literal finding.

hardcodedStringMinLength.description: constants: minimum string length to be a hardcoded-string candidate.

fileLinesFail.description: large-file: lines at/above this => error (split candidate).

fileFunctionsWarn.description: large-file: top-level function count at/above this => warning.

complexityWarn.description: complexity: cyclomatic complexity at/above this => warning.

complexityFail.description: complexity: cyclomatic complexity at/above this => error.

maxFunctionLines.description: simplify: physical function span above this many lines => warning (SIM-LONG-001).

maxNestingDepth.description: governance: control flow nesting depth at/above this => warning.

maxInheritanceDepth.description: governance: class inheritance depth at/above this => warning.

ignoreLiterals.description: constants: literal texts exempt from the hardcoded-string and duplicate-literal passes, matched with or without quotes (e.g. `"/"`, `".."`). Cascades only because the constants analyzer declares the key; the per-analyzer `options.ignoreLiterals` wins over this global layer.

checkCrossFunctionComplexity.description: complexity: analyze composite polynomial complexity across multi-file call chains.

distinguishBoundedCollections.description: complexity: distinguish small bounded enum/config arrays from unbounded dynamic streams.

checkUnboundedQueries.description: data-architecture: flag unpaginated or unbounded queries on online request paths.

checkNPlusOne.description: data-architecture: flag N+1 database/storage queries inside loops.

checkRedundantSerialization.description: data-architecture: flag repeated serialization cycles in adjacent layers or iterations.

checkDefensiveExcess.description: data-architecture: flag excessive redundant defensive validation in trusted internal domains.

minEmtd.description: test-modernity: minimum acceptable Effective Modern Test Density score.

minCbcr.description: test-modernity: minimum acceptable Current Business Contract Coverage Rate.

flagDeprecatedContractTests.description: test-modernity: flag test suites asserting deprecated or mock-only stubs.

flagTautologicalAssertions.description: test-modernity: flag non-verifying or tautological assertions.

enforceFileLayout.description: dependency-layout: enforce language-specific file layout and import grouping ordering.

allowAuditedInFunctionImports.description: dependency-layout: allow in-function imports with explicit @lazy/@optional audit tag.

flagUnmanagedResources.description: dependency-layout: flag hardcoded remote URLs in business logic.

enforceHeadless.description: architecture: enforce headless decoupling of core domain from UI/IDE presentation.

flagCrossDomainBypass.description: architecture: flag cross-domain private module bypasses.

flagMutableGlobalCoupling.description: architecture: flag implicit shared mutable global state coupling decoupled domains.

analyzers.description: Declarative registry of enabled analyzers and per-analyzer options. Every built-in analyzer runs by default, so an entry is only needed to disable one (`enabled: false`) or to override its options.

customAnalyzers.description: EXTERNAL PLUG-INS. Each entry loads a module at runtime via require(module); the module must export a class/object implementing analyze(sf, ctx). No engine change needed.

name.description: Analyzer id; must match a key in analyzers to be enabled.

module.description: Module path (relative to this config file) or package specifier.

signals.description: Mutation signals that trigger this custom analyzer.

track.description: Execution track for this custom analyzer.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity. Logs go to stderr so stdout stays machine-readable; with logFile they also append to a file.

logFile.description: Optional log file (append). When set, logs mirror there in addition to stderr.

concurrency.description: File-level parallelism: max files analyzed concurrently. Default = min(4, os.cpus().length).

workers.description: Worker-thread parallelism for the parse+analyze stage. 0 = auto (default): threads scale with the batch size (files / 24, capped at min(cores, 8)), so small scans stay in-process and many-file scans spread across cores — measured 26–29% faster on a 300-file corpus, while 12 large files correctly stay in-process. 1 = force the in-process path. N > 1 = exactly N worker threads. Files are independent, so this parallelizes across cores without changing findings.

respectGitignore.description: If true, honor a root-level .gitignore when discovering files, in addition to the exclude list. Prevents scanning generated/ignored artifacts (correctness + performance).

failOnAnalyzerError.description: If true, an analyzer that throws is reported as an 'error' Issue (can fail CI via failOnIssue). If false, such faults are reported as 'info' and never fail the build.

parser.description: TS/JS-family parser: 'typescript' (default, ts.createSourceFile) or 'oxc' (Rust oxc-parser engine). The oxc parser produces byte-equivalent normalized output (see docs/02-parsers-and-ast/02-oxc-fastpath.md) with ~3x faster parsing. Rust files are unaffected.

incremental.description: Line-level incremental switch (docs/03-incremental-and-diff/01-line-level-incremental.md). Default OFF. The runtime gate AR_INCREMENTAL=1 (environment) wins; this field is the declarative equivalent used by the daemon warm path. Only affects big-file-small-change rescans (daemon-only).

incrementalMinLines.description: Minimum file line count to attempt line-level incremental (docs/03-incremental-and-diff/01-line-level-incremental.md). Files below this threshold use the existing file-level L2 path (diff/cache-management would be net-negative).

cache.description: CLI/API warm-scan flag (NOT a ScanConfig field — accepted for CLI symmetry). Enables the two-level incremental cache (<root>/.auto-refactor-cache). CLI defaults to --cache; the scan() API defaults to off (zero implicit disk writes).

cacheDir.description: CLI/API warm-scan flag. Cache directory; default <root>/.auto-refactor-cache. A shared --cache-dir is namespaced per project by root-path hash.

cacheCustom.description: CLI/API warm-scan flag. When custom analyzers are present, L2 result caching is disabled by default (their purity cannot be proven). Set true to enable L2 by hashing each custom module's path + content + options into the cache key.

daemon.description: CLI/API warm-scan mode (NOT a ScanConfig field). 'off' (API default) never connects; 'auto' probes an EXISTING daemon only (CLI default, <5ms, no auto-start); 'on' auto-starts the daemon when missing (CLI --daemon).

failOnSeverity.description: Generalized severity gate: exit non-zero when any blocking issue has severity >= this level. With a baseline, applies to NEW issues only.

matchFile.description: Issue file path to match: an exact repository-relative path, or a glob (e.g. `scripts/**`, `app/cli/*.py`). Suppressed findings stay in the report with their reason.

suppressions.description: Declarative, reason-carrying suppressions applied post-scan. Matched issues stay in the report (auditable); downgradeTo lowers severity, otherwise excluded from gate counting.

governanceExemptions.description: Centralized governance exemption ledger (governance-exemptions.json). Each exemption must specify ruleId, exact workspace-relative file path, symbol, owner, reason, and an expiration timestamp (expiresAt).

file.description: Exact workspace-relative file path (no globs permitted).

profile.description: Agent execution security profile determining governance and gating thresholds.

baselineGranularity.description: Baseline ratchet granularity: id = exact issue ids (line-sensitive); grouped = analyzer|rule|file counts (tolerant to line shifts).

commentLevel.description: Comment audit strictness level: 'off' (skip all), 'basic' (header & symbols), 'standard' (JSDoc/Docstring intent), 'strict' (6-field industrial contract & concurrency annotations).

securityLevel.description: Three-level systemic security audit gate: 'off' (disable security checks), 'basic' (hardcoded tokens/keys, severe vulnerabilities, and core architecture leaks), 'full' (entropy scan, weak crypto/pseudo-randomness, prototype pollution, command/path injection, and strict layer boundary data leaks).

unsupportedLanguage.description: Fail-closed guard for source files whose extension no language adapter claims (e.g. .py/.sh before an adapter exists). 'error' (default) fails the scan loudly, 'warning' reports without blocking, 'off' restores the historic silent fallback to the TypeScript parser.

autoTune.description: Automatically adjust complexity, file size, and rule thresholds based on detected project scale (micro -> enterprise).

profile.description: Optional project profile and architecture layer overrides.

memory.description: Enable Review Memory, fingerprint indexing and semantic domain reuse.

agentUid.description: Executing Agent UID for multi-agent evolution and trajectory tracking.

scoringWeights.description: Configurable weights for the 10 transparent quality dimensions.

maturityTier.description: Governance maturity tier. 'demo' relaxes constraints for speed; 'industrial' enforces mission-critical zero-tolerance gates.

classifyLiterals.description: Classify raw literals into specialized semantic domains (URLs, ports, HTTP status, paths, SVGs) and suppress benign delimiters in all three constants passes — magic-number, hardcoded-string and duplicate-literal.

granularRules.description: Emit granular rule IDs (e.g. literal-url, literal-port) instead of generic magic-number or hardcoded-string.
